scenarios.name: short_export
scenarios.invariant: a one-row export must not produce a nonzero bandwidth

scenarios.name: duplicate_frequency
scenarios.invariant: a failing point breaks the band; duplicates take the worst value

scenarios.name: mhz_units
scenarios.invariant: an MHz file yields GHz frequencies (24, not 24000)

scenarios.name: sqlite_lock
scenarios.invariant: a finished run is recorded once the lock clears, not lost

scenarios.name: licence_refusal
scenarios.title: 许可证不可用
scenarios.invariant: a licence problem is an environment failure with an actionable hint

scenarios.name: worker_death
scenarios.invariant: the task survives the death, is attempted twice, recorded once
